name: mermaid-render
description: Draws Mermaid diagrams in Claude Code's terminal replies as colored Unicode box art; wide ones scroll inside a box in the reply. A side pane gathers the diagrams of plans and replies to step through.

steer.title: Ask Claude to write diagrams as Mermaid
steer.description: Adds a short system-prompt section asking Claude to draw diagrams as mermaid blocks instead of ASCII art.
